overview: Cleghorne! focuses on the life of Ellen Carlson, a single mom trying to raise her 9 year old daughter Akeyla, balance her duties of running a local production company in SoHo, boyfriend Brad, and overbearing parents, Sidney and Lena.
title: Cleghorne!

overview: Adult Trainee tells the tale of hormonal teenagers as their bodies mature. There is Jae Min, who gets addicted to masturbation, conservative Yu Ra who begins a risqué rendezvous with her male friend and overweight Na Eun who's never had a boyfriend before. The drama aims to express the raw and truthful worries and love stories of 18 year olds in a way that Gen Z can relate to.
title: Adult Trainee

overview: The rumor has it that Yun Qian Yue, the eldest daughter of Prince Yun manor; is playful, arrogant and illiterate. In reality, the rumors were spread intentionally by Qian Yue herself because she does not want to marry into the Imperial Family. Qian Yue has also been in disguise as Ye Tian Shuo's subordinate for nearly a decade. She is in love with Rong Jing from the Prince Rong manor but is oppressed by the Imperial Family's authority. Rong Jing, a man who possesses extraordinary good looks, suffers from a disease that left him weak and sick for years due to the aftereffects of aphrodisiac. To find a cure for him, Qian Yue triggers the Phoenix flight without a care for consequences. However at the same time, the current Emperor Ye Qing Ran is deeply in love with Qian Yue and to gain her love, he puts a life-and-death lock heart poison into her body, thus forbidding her from leaving his side. Despite losing her memories due to the poison, Yun Qian Yue does not forget her true heart.
title: Bright As the Moon

overview: True Crime Story: Indefensible – From a completely unexpected, but dazzlingly effective host – a gonzo and highly personal approach to the genre. With a modern feminist perspective, Jena Friedman is bringing the slightly comedic, deadpan and disarming interview concept popularized by the Daily Show to the True Crime genre; with which she unearths the hidden elements in cases that tell the real story.
title: True Crime Story: Indefensible

overview: This comedy revolves around an ordinary girl who works in one of the big fashion houses, where she is exposed to people of a higher social strata. The experience leaves her with the feeling that she is not beautiful, meanwhile her profession puts her in a series of dramatic and bizarre situations.
title: Ugly Heba

overview: Lords of War brings you inside the intriguing world of historical weaponry as Sean Rich and his team of weapons experts travel across the country in search of the best in antique weapons and militaria. Journey through history as the guys assess, test, and auction the bounties of war.
title: Lords of War

overview: Colonel March of Scotland Yard is based on the character created by John Dickson Carr under the pen name Carter Dickson. Boris Karloff, famous for his affiliation with Universal Studios during the "Golden Age of Hollywood Horror Movies," portrays Colonel March, of the Department of Queer Complaints who investigates unusual cases, locked-room murders, and mysteries concerning the supernatural. The British series was filmed at Southhall Studios, Middlesex, England from December 1954 - Spring 1955. Boris, 65 years old at the time, as Colonel March is not afraid to get right into the thick of things, often confronting the perpetrators directly. In 1953, a film called Colonel March Investigates was made by Fountain Films Production. It combined three episodes (Hot Money, Death in the Dressing Room, and The New Invisible Man) Karloff narrates the three segments and stars as the lead.
title: Colonel March of Scotland Yard

overview: Student In Ha one day receives an anonymous love letter through a supernatural portal - a white hole.
title: Love in Black Hole

overview: Nothing foreshadowed trouble on the day when Igor found out that his wife Natalia had died suddenly. He was left alone with two daughters and a lot of questions. Why did the mother-in-law drop the phrase that he might not be the father of the girls? Why did Natalia keep the second phone in secret? And how do you raise children if you've been missing from work before? Igor will have to balance between parental worries and a painful investigation. He even hires a private investigator to find out at any cost how his wife lived and died.
title: Инсайт

overview: Property and design enthusiast Tinie Tempah follows homeowners as they unleash their inner architect and build beautiful, often radical and 'out there' home extensions
title: Extraordinary Extensions

overview: Mel Giedroyc hosts as talented, good-with-wood craftspeople compete to be crowned Britain's best woodworker by award-winning architect Alex de Rijke and queen of furniture making Helen Welch.
title: Handmade: Britain's Best Woodworker

overview: "Lockdown" takes viewers inside the closed world of three maximum-security U.S. prisons to observe violent clashes, covert rules and secret codes of justice.
title: Lockdown

overview: Michael is joined by his culinary director and right-hand, Katie Pickens, as they challenge the best of the best in the culinary world, with Michael taking on that chef's signature dish and challenging them to a good old-fashioned Throwdown. The catch – Michael doesn't know who he is going up against and the chefs don't know Michael is coming. Through four episodes, Michael will cook alongside the opposition, bringing his competitive spirit and creativity to the dishes that he is challenged to make while a crowd of spectators watch on. Each Throwdown has three total points at stake, with a pair of special guest judges blind tasting the dishes along with the audience in attendance, to determine the winner and see who has the ultimate Throwdown bragging rights.
title: Throwdown with Michael Symon

overview: The dating experiment comes to Brazil as local singles look for true love and get engaged, all without meeting the other person face to face.
title: Casamento às Cegas: Brasil

overview: The story is about the beautiful, talented magistrate Tao Jun Zhan (Luo Zheng) and the daring, eccentric Ah Fan (Huang Zhi Ying). The action takes place in Biyun County, known as "the city that never sleeps". Each of them pursues their own goals, but, going through a series of insidious life trials, unconsciously they gradually get closer to each other.
title: Cry Me A River of Stars

overview: Award-winning author Dylan Jones celebrates the music of the decade, arguing that this maligned era is one of the most inventive periods of pop culture and hearing from leading musicians and producers who were at the forefront.
title: The 80s - Music's Greatest Decade?

overview: Harlan County, Kentucky, is no stranger to violence. Its long mining history means it's seen its fair share of corruption, moon-shining, and murder. The coal mining wars may be over, but with a depressed economy, including the closure of many mines, the county is facing a new crime wave: a growing prescription drug problem.
title: Kentucky Justice

overview: Join former All Black Andy Ellis as he helps New Zealanders relocate their dream homes across stunning locations, while encountering the unique challenges associated with this form recycling on a grand scale!
title: Moving Houses

overview: The game involves a team of experts consisting of six people. They have to answer the questions sent by the viewers. Each correct answer to a question gives a team one point, an incorrect answer gives a point to the audience team. When one of the teams scores six points, it wins. The questions are selected randomly by rotating the spinning top. The question where the arrow stops is selected for the game. If the question that appears has already been played, then the next question that has not yet been played is selected clockwise. The discussion lasts for one minute. At the end of the discussion, the team captain should name an expert who will give an answer. Usually the word is given to the author of the version.
title: Що? Де? Коли?

overview: With the unique insights and experience of Ugly Delicious creators Morgan Neville and David Chang take a tangy look at food and our relationship to it past, present and future. Why do we eat what we eat and are we missing something better? What will we be eating in the future and why?
title: The Next Thing You Eat

overview: In the early 2000s, Yoo Young-chul hammered his victims to death and cast fear across Seoul. This docuseries recounts the hunt for a prolific killer.
title: The Raincoat Killer: Chasing a Predator in Korea

overview: Twelve people think they're in the final casting round for a reality show. In fact, they're already being secretly filmed, with 100,000 euros at stake.
title: Insiders

overview: Spanish comedy TV show where Joaquín Reyes and his friends let his imagination fly. Absurd humour and hilarious imitations of well known celebrities will try to make you laugh in 30 minutes per show, with a total of 52 episodes.
title: Muchachada Nui

overview: Lene Kongsvik Johansen is back with a fresh comedy series where both new and well-known characters work and take a holiday in the idyllic little summer town Kongsvika.
title: Kongsvika

overview: As his return to mining nears, Todd Hoffman and crew reveal new insights.
title: Gold Rush The Dirt: The Hoffman Story

overview: The explorer is joined by his actor cousin Joseph Fiennes to embark on a journey following the course of the river in a re-creation of his 1969 expedition.
title: The Nile with Sir Ranulph Fiennes

overview: Haunted by these stories of vanished loved ones and driven by the need for attention and assistance for these forgotten women, former law enforcement officer Derrica and public relations expert Natalie operate a grassroots organization that raises awareness in communities, alerts media outlets to the plight of thousands of women and children and urges police departments to allocate more resources to this scourge.
title: Black and Missing

overview: In Cell 8, a man presumed dead is arrested on a ferry between Sweden and Finland, throwing detectives Mariana Hermansson and Ewert Grens into a mysterious and increasingly dark series of events. The case soon reveals a personal connection not only to Hermansson herself, but to a Death Row prisoner in the US and a grieving parent consumed by the quest for revenge.
title: Cell 8

overview: Six celebrities will, together with some of the country's best artists and producers, try to write and produce a national hit. Every Saturday, celebrities have to perform their songs live. Viewers' votes determine who joins.
title: Norges nye megahit

overview: Social media maven and celebrity blogger B. Scott sits down with the cast of Twenties and their famous friends to discuss the biggest moments from each episode.
title: Twenties After Show with B. Scott

overview: Get to know the girls on Norway's only professional cycling team. Some want to join the team when the world elite come to Norway, while others try to fight back from injury. Everyone has their goals and dreams, and hers are their stories.
title: Den tøffe veien

overview: Season 4 of Hard Time leaves the world of prison behind to go to jail in the most iconic city in America — Vegas. It's a new world filled with new stories, where guilt or innocence hangs in the balance.
title: Hard Time
The Complete and Utter History of Britain

overview: Jefferson Keyes is an international investigator who charges $1 million for each case he takes.
title: Cool Million

overview: A surreal series in the mould of 'The Avengers', The Corridor People ran for only four episodes yet has garnered some considerable cult devotion. A host of unlikely characters include Kronk, a paternal CID agent, his henchmen Inspector Blood and Sergeant Hound, and American, Bogart-worshipping private eye Phil Scrotty; each episode sees them pitched against the avaricious schems of Syrie Van Epp, a beautiful, treacherous Persian millionairess. Made by Granada Television for the ITV Network.
title: The Corridor People

overview: A birthday is a good day of every year that many people wait for, but for some, maybe it's the day when the shore takes away memories that you don't want to remember. And it is an inevitable pain because this day will be with us every year for the rest of our lives.
title: Club Friday The Series: Unhappy Birthday

overview: Report series in which Ewout Genemans dives into various social arenas and walks along with those involved. Ewout discovers the dark side of the paradise island of Curaçao and goes into an internment at a juvenile detention center in the Netherlands where he sees how young criminal the Netherlands is now. He also follows girls who, under pressure from social media, have plastic surgery performed in Turkey. And that can involve major risks.
title: Ewout:

overview: After an enormously successful 23-year career as a radio personality, Wendy Williams concocted The Wendy Williams Show in July of 2008, which became nationally syndicated in its first season. Dubbed a "breakthrough in daytime" by The New York Times, The Wendy Williams Show airs in 52 countries and on BET weekdays at midnight. The show is a direct mirror image of its host. From the upbeat theme music to the eye-catching decor on set, Wendy brings to life segments like "Ask Wendy," where audience members receive real-life advice from the host herself and "Hot Topics," where she dishes her touch-and-go, authentic opinion on the juiciest headlines.
title: The Wendy Williams Show

overview: Modern take on Armenian theatrical play written in 1904 by Armenian writer Shirvanzade about how far a person can go out of greed. Story tells about greedy businessman Andreas Elizbaryan and honest young man Artashes Otaryan who's in love with Andreas's daughter Margarit. Unlike her father and sister, Margarit is very honest and sincere person.
title: Պատվի համար

overview: Extended TV-version of movie adaptation of the eponymous 19th-c. novel by Armenian writer Raffi. It tells the story of Iranian Armenians who chose forgery, murder, deceit and theft, usually accompanied by murder, as their source of income. They would travel through various regions and countries and present themselves as members of the nation or religious group they want to steal from. They'd thoroughly study the nation they wanted to steal from, its beliefs and traditions to be able to perfectly mimic their behaviour and religious features and thus they'd easily pass as a member of that nation or religious group.
title: Խաչագողի հիշատակարանը

overview: Always Jane is an intimate and unguarded look at transgender teenager Jane Noury and her family as she prepares to leave home for college. The series reveals a family with unconditional love that shines through as they tackle obstacles head-on so that Jane can live authentically. Navigating deeply personal and challenging issues, the Noury family's uplifting humor and kindness is always present, revealing the transformative power of acceptance, support, and love.
title: Always Jane

overview: Auctioneer Angus Ashworth and his team help famous faces clear their homes of clutter, hoping to discover hidden gems to be auctioned off for serious profits.
title: Celebrity Yorkshire Auction House

overview: The stories of women and men who were children during World War II.
title: Barn i krig

overview: The hosts of NRK Super give the children the most enjoyable May 17 party of all time.
title: Barnas 17. mai-fest

overview: Musical entertainment program for children.
title: Barnas musikkverksted

overview: Children's own supershow! For and with children.
title: Barnas Supershow

overview: Ghost Hunters follows a group of real-life ghostbusters as they investigate reported hauntings throughout the country. Plumbers by trade, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson head up a group of intrepid souls that are far from the usual collection of be-spectacled Ph.D.s. They're ordinary, everyday people with an interest in getting to the bottom of your otherworldly disturbances.
title: Ghost Hunters

overview: Tarek is a self-proclaimed real estate genius with determination and drive. Christina is Tarek's picture-perfect wife, who Tarek's friends still can't believe he landed. In each episode of Flip or Flop, Tarek and Christina flip a new property. From the nail-biting purchase at auction, to the frustrating renovations and maddening showings, to the giddy acceptance of an offer, we'll follow along as these two relatively novice flippers try their hand at the toughest game in town. From purchase to resale, weaving their personal lives within the story of the flip. From paying cash, sight unseen, for a property at auction, through the hapless remodeling process, to the frantic sale, this young couple is putting everything they have into this venture.
title: Flip or Flop

overview: Nadat de Federale Wegenpolitie heeft gereden, is Luk Alloo nu te zien op nationale en regionale snelwegen, waar hij wordt geconfronteerd met een nieuw arsenaal aan methoden.
title: Alloo bij de Verkeerspolitie

overview: Program series on child development.
title: Barnet

overview: Music program for children with songs by Visvas and Sidsel Mørck.
title: Barneval

overview: Musical concert with Arve Tellefsen and Oslo Filharmoniske Orkester.
title: Barokk-konsert med Arve Tellefsen og Oslo Filharmoniske Orkester

overview: Beassášrihkus is an easter crime series for children.
title: Beassášrihkus - Påskekrim

overview: Four participants will be helped to change their lifestyle to have a better life and get in the best shape of their lives. Health and lifestyle program.
title: Bedre puls

overview: Lars Berrum and Martin Beyer-Olsen lead Berrum & Beyer - The World's Best Talk Show, with the most absurd and incredible experiences you can dream of, and guests that all talk shows fantasize about, but do not have the opportunity to have. The surprises will hit you on the ground and tantalizing elements will get you on your knees, in the talk show that extends even a little further. Berrum & Beyer is the program where you have to find out who you are, before you can find out what you think.
title: Berrum & Beyer

overview: Join Bertine on a visit to exciting animals.
title: Bertine på besøk

overview: Torkjell Berulfsen travels back in history.
title: Berulfsens historiske perler

overview: In America's largest and wildest state, just 400 Alaska State Troopers are responsible for patrolling hundreds of miles in Fairbanks and the Mat-Su Valley and serve more than 230 remote villages only reachable by boat or plane. From the endless light of summer to the deep freeze of winter, each one-hour episode captures these men and women as they patrol the vast frontier by land, sea, and air. Alaska is the final stop for fugitives on the run, where danger is vast, distances are brutal, and backup can be hours away. From multi-agency criminal takedowns to life-saving search and rescue missions, the series showcases a range of calls Alaska State Troopers face that are as immense and unpredictable as the state itself.
title: Alaska State Troopers

overview: Norwegian documentary series that gives you the most beautiful memories, the strongest emotions and the finest stories sports can offer.
title: Best i verden

overview: We follow 6 children who go on overnight visits to their grandparents. With grandma and grandpa, they get to join many fun and exciting activities.
title: Bestemor og bestefar

overview: Folk music program. Presentation of the fiddler Erling Kjøk from Garmo in Lom.
title: Besøk hos Erling Kjøk

overview: Popular science entertainment program hosted by Ingrid Gjessing Linhave and Kåre Magnus Bergh. An expert panel tries to answer Linhave and Bergh's many questions about big and small.
title: Big bang

overview: Arisawa Ichika is a second-year college student at a prestigious private university. She is not interested in romance and enjoys playing an online game called "Tenkyo", which she ranks 6th under the username "Vivi". On the other hand, Onoda Asahi is also a student at the same university. He is popular and is given the nickname "Prince" due to his good looks and ability in excelling everything. He also plays the same online game and ranks 1st under the username "Leon". Ichika and Asahi met each other in the game and began to get attracted to each other online. They decided to meet in reality and were surprised at the difference in their lives. Despite this, they are still attracted to each other and start dating. However, Ichika continues her "Cinderella life" as she gets attacked by various people around her for dating "Prince" Asahi. Will the two be able to find a happy ending with their first love?
title: Cinderella is Online

overview: This series tells the story of an innocent and kind-hearted and pro-prince and a mysterious foreign country. He overcomes difficulties and grows into a more mature and responsible pro-prince without adapting to the customs and environment of the foreign race.
title: Princess! You have Five Husbands!

overview: Sarah Richardson tackles the renovation of her own weekend getaway. Located 17 miles offshore and purchased by her husband as a bachelor shack, this tiny island cottage is completely off the grid with a combination of solar, wind and propane energy. It's rustic, relaxing and at one with the stunning lake scenery. Character, storage and versatility are key as Sarah untangles the renovation processes with tip after tip on how to handle an out-of-town reno — without having an out-of-body experience
title: Sarah's Summer House

overview: Missouri brothers Taimoor and Rehan Nana transform unconventional structures across the US into luxurious homes. From an old carnival trailer to an industrial garbage dumpster, they use business savvy and artistic talent to create eccentric properties
title: Bizarre Builds

overview: Cake artists compete to make the best cake tribute to the famous parade.
title: Macy's Thanksgiving Cake Spectacular

overview: The Rocky Mountains, scattered with more than 3,000 miles of dense forests and rocky peaks, create the perfect hideaway for fugitives on the run from the law. In Animal Planet's new six-part series, Rocky Mountain Bounty Hunters, two teams of elite fugitive retrieval agents are in hot pursuit of armed and unpredictable delinquents who've skipped bail, preferring the treacherous mountainous terrain to facing justice behind bars.
title: Rocky Mountain Bounty Hunters

overview: Passion and creativity run high as six of the most memorable designers from past seasons of HGTV Design Star battle it out for a second chance in the spotlight on HGTV Design Star All Stars. The four-episode series premiering on Tuesday, July 31, at 9 p.m. ET/PT, will have the contestants compete for an appearance on an HGTV show, $25,000 in cash and the opportunity to be named HGTV's first Design Star All Stars champion. Contestants include: Kellie Clements, Edmond, Okla.; Leslie Ezelle, Dallas, Texas; Josh Johnson "Sparkle Josh," West Hollywood, Calif.; Tom Vecchione, New York City, N.Y.; Dan Vickery, Los Angeles, Calif.; and Hilari Younger, Dallas, Texas. Each week, the six competitors must showcase their expertise, unmatched designs and on-camera finesse to avoid being eliminated. Designers Genevieve Gorder and Vern Yip will evaluate the contestants' work each week to determine who will continue on in the competition. They will be joined by host David Bromstad (season one winner of HGTV Design Star), along with special guest judges Emily Procter (CSI: Miami), Mindy Cohn (Facts of Life) and HGTV's Monica Pedersen (HGTV Green Home 2012) and Carter Oosterhouse (Million Dollar Rooms).
title: HGTV Design Star All Stars

overview: A talking show in which famous people talk about themselves and their views on life through five books that have influenced them. The host is the poetess Vera Polozkova.
title: 5 книг
